text: {"reconstruction":4,"feasibility":3,"rationale":"The proposal gets the right overall procedure, order and parameters (cuisine, area, dish) and the note template, but it leaves out the \"4 or more stars\" filter on the recipe and the \"don't click a time slot/Reserve\" constraint, and it adds unneeded OpenTable defaults (London, today, 20:00, 2 people) and lists restaurant and recipe_time as parameters even though they're derived values, so an automation could be built but would likely pick the wrong recipe."}

data.rationale: The proposal gets the right overall procedure, order and parameters (cuisine, area, dish) and the note template, but it leaves out the "4 or more stars" filter on the recipe and the "don't click a time slot/Reserve" constraint, and it adds unneeded OpenTable defaults (London, today, 20:00, 2 people) and lists restaurant and recipe_time as parameters even though they're derived values, so an automation could be built but would likely pick the wrong recipe.
